en.title: 5. Venue Location & Range Setup
en.excerpt: Setting up tournament coordinates, Google Maps navigation, field orientation standards, and athlete facilities.
en.content:
Venue Coordinates & Map Integration

Tournament location details appear directly on athlete registration receipts, PDF Result Books, and mobile invitations. Under Tournament Overview > Venue Details, you can specify:

  • Venue Name: Stadium, sports center, or private archery range (e.g., Stadion Maguwoharjo Archery Field).
  • Full Address: Street name, district, regency, province, and postal code.
  • Google Maps Coordinates: Latitude and longitude coordinates to generate one-tap GPS navigation buttons for visiting archers.

Field Orientation & Sun Glare Standards

When preparing outdoor archery ranges, World Archery standards recommend pointing the shooting line towards the North / North-East:

  • This orientation prevents blinding direct sunlight from striking the eyes of archers during morning and afternoon shooting waves.
  • Ensure sufficient safety overshoot buffer zones (minimum 25-50 meters behind the target butt line or safety netting).

Athlete Amenities & Zone Layout

Organizers can document range amenities to inform incoming delegations:

  • Waiting Tents & Quiver Racks: Covered athlete rest areas situated behind the waiting line.
  • Equipment Inspection Desk: Dedicated check-in area for bow scale draw weight checks, arrow diameter inspection, and finger tab validation.
  • Scorekeeper Desk: Central operations hub equipped with WiFi/hotspot and power charging stations for field devices.

Participant Travel & Access Directions

Provide specific parking details, nearby hotel recommendations, and drop-off zones in the event description to streamline morning arrival for athletes carrying large hard-shell bowcases.
